mime_type.description: MIME type of the uploaded file. MUST be one of the allowed types listed. The server applies stricter image-specific size limits when mime_type indicates an image.

size.description: File size in bytes. Server validates per-file size limits before creating the metadata record. Business limits: images <= 5,242,880 bytes (5 MB); non-image documents <= 20,971,520 bytes (20 MB). The server enforces the applicable limit based on mime_type.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating the file is an image; the server may infer this from mime_type. When true the server will enforce the stricter image size limit (<= 5,242,880 bytes). This field is optional because the server will derive the authoritative value from mime_type and content inspection.

IDiscussionBoardComment.description: Comment entity returned by the API representing a discussion_board_comments row. Includes soft-delete state (deletedAt) and moderation visibility (isHidden). Maps to Prisma model discussion_board_comments.

articleId.description: Identifier of the parent article (discussion_board_articles.id). This value is supplied by the path parameter when creating/listing comments and is used to scope the comment (maps to discussion_board_comment.discussion_board_article_id).

oneOf.description: Identifier of the parent comment when this is a reply. Null for root-level comments.

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment id (discussion_board_comments.discussion_board_parent_comment_id). Nullable for root comments or when parent was removed.

author.description: Author summary object derived from discussion_board_author_id. Nullable when the author account was anonymized or removed. The server sets author from the authenticated user when creating comments.

content.description: Comment body text. Server enforces content length and sanitization. Business rule: max 500 characters for MVP; server must validate and sanitize before persisting.

isHidden.description: Indicates whether the comment is hidden due to moderation or automated heuristics (maps to discussion_board_comments.is_hidden). Controlled by moderation systems; clients must not set this field.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_comments.created_at.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_comments.updated_at.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp (discussion_board_comments.deleted_at). Nullable; presence indicates the comment was soft-deleted and subject to retention/purge rules. Returned to authorized callers per RBAC/audit rules.

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

search.description: Full-text/trigram search applied to comment content.

authorId.description: Optional filter by author id (discussion_board_member.id). Null or omitted to disable author filtering.

oneOf.description: Optional filter to restrict results to replies of a specific parent comment (UUID).

parentCommentId.description: Optional filter to restrict results to replies of a specific parent comment. Null or omitted to include root-level comments.

includeThreaded.description: When true, server may return a threaded representation (tree) where supported; otherwise a flat list is returned. Default: false.

oneOf.description: Sort order for results: createdAt ascending.
Sort order for results: createdAt descending.

sort.description: Sort order for results. Allowed values: 'createdAt', '-createdAt'. Default is '-createdAt' (newest first).

includeHidden.description: When true and caller is authorized (moderator/admin), include comments with is_hidden = true. Public callers MUST NOT receive hidden comments; the server MUST ignore this flag for public callers and require elevated privileges to honor it. Access to hidden content should be audited.

includeDeleted.description: When true and caller is authorized (moderator/admin), include soft-deleted comments (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Public callers must not receive deleted records; servers must enforce RBAC and audit accesses returning deleted items.

createdFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound filter for comment created_at (ISO 8601 datetime). Nullable; when provided server MUST validate createdFrom <= createdTo if createdTo is present.

createdTo.description: Inclusive upper bound filter for comment created_at (ISO 8601 datetime). Nullable; when provided server MUST validate createdFrom <= createdTo if createdFrom is present.

IDiscussionBoardComment.IRequest.description: Request DTO for listing comments of a specific article. Supports pagination, optional search, author/parent filters, threaded representation, sorting and date-range filters. NOTE: The articleId MUST be supplied as the path parameter and MUST NOT appear in the request body. The server enforces exclusion of path parameters from the body and will return 400 on duplication. Moderator-only flags (includeHidden, includeDeleted) require elevated privileges and must be audited when honored.

IDiscussionBoardComment.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a comment on an article.
Security: This operation requires an authenticated member (authorizationActor: "member"). The server WILL set the author id from the authenticated JWT; clients MUST NOT supply author id. The article id is supplied as a path parameter and MUST NOT be duplicated in the request body.
Business rules: content is required and must respect product length constraints (application-enforced; max 500 characters). parentCommentId is optional and, when provided, must reference a comment in the same article and not produce a reply depth exceeding configured limits.

content.description: Comment body text. Required. Must respect product policy length constraints (application-enforces max length, e.g., 500 characters).

oneOf.description: Optional identifier of the parent comment to create a reply. Server will validate that the parent exists, belongs to the same article, and that reply depth does not exceed policy.
Explicit null indicates a root-level comment.

parentCommentId.description: Optional parent comment id (UUID) or null. Matches nullable DB column discussion_board_parent_comment_id.

IDiscussionBoardComment.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing comment. Only mutable fields are present. Ownership and edit-window checks are enforced by the server; clients MUST NOT attempt to modify article association or parent reference. All fields are optional; unspecified fields are left unchanged. Server enforces edit-window and content length policy (max 500 characters) and records audit entries; clients MUST NOT provide author identifiers.

content.description: Updated comment text. The server enforces edit-window and content validation. Use omission to leave content unchanged. When provided, content must be between 1 and 500 characters (business-authoritative limit from Business Rules).

IDiscussionBoardComment.IUpdate.title: IDiscussionBoardComment.IUpdate (normalized)

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISumma.description: Public-safe summary representation of a comment attachment. Use this schema for public listing and article/comment detail endpoints. This variant intentionally omits the internal `storageKey` and exposes time-limited `downloadUrl`/`cdnUrl` when access is permitted. Fields reflect Prisma nullability: uploader is nullable.

originalFilename.description: Original filename as supplied by the uploader.

mimeType.description: MIME type for the file (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).

isImage.description: True if the attachment is an image type.

quarantined.description: Indicates whether the attachment is quarantined. Public consumers must not receive download links for quarantined attachments.

createdAt.description: Upload timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC).

downloadUrl.description: Signed, time-limited download URL. Provided only when the caller is authorized and the attachment is not quarantined. Null otherwise.

cdnUrl.description: Optional public CDN URL for the attachment when publicly available. Nullable when not provided or access restricted.

uploader.description: Optional uploader summary for attribution; nullable when the uploading member was anonymized or removed.

storage_key.description: Object storage key or URI referencing a previously uploaded file. Clients MUST upload the binary to configured object storage before referencing the key here. The server will validate that the storage_key resolves to an existing, persisted object and that storage metadata (size, content-type) matches the submitted values before creating the attachment metadata record.

original_filename.description: Original filename supplied by the uploader at time of upload. This value is stored in discussion_board_comment_attachments.original_filename and used for display, export and download filename hints.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported on upload (e.g., image/png, application/pdf). The server validates allowed MIME types (images: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp; documents: application/pdf, text/plain, application/msword, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet). The server may override this value if content inspection reveals a different type.

size.description: File size in bytes as reported by the client. The server validates this value against configured per-file size limits and against the persisted storage object's metadata. Business limits applied by the server: images SHOULD be <= 5,242,880 bytes (5 MB); non-image documents up to 26,214,400 bytes (~25 MB). The server is authoritative and will reject mismatches or oversized files.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating whether the file is an image. The server will infer is_image from mime_type/content and is authoritative for image-specific processing (thumbnailing, stricter size limits). Clients MAY provide this as a hint but the server may ignore or override it.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ICreat.description: Single manifest item used when creating comment attachments. References a pre-uploaded storage object via `storage_key`. Required metadata (original_filename, mime_type, size) is enforced so the server can validate and persist a discussion_board_comment_attachments row. Clients MUST NOT supply server-managed fields such as `quarantined`, `created_at` or `discussion_board_uploaded_by_id`. The server will run malware/abuse scans and, if flagged, will set `quarantined = true` and not expose a public download URL to regular callers.

attachments.description: Array of attachment manifest items referencing pre-uploaded storage objects. The server enforces per-comment attachment quota (MVP: max 1) atomically within a DB transaction. Clients MUST upload files to storage and then reference the resulting storage_key here. The server will validate mime_type and size, run malware/abuse scans, and set `quarantined = true` for flagged files. Clients MUST NOT include path parameters (articleId, commentId) in the body, nor server-managed fields (quarantined, created_at, discussion_board_uploaded_by_id). On success the server returns attachment summaries (IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISummary) that include signed publicUrl/cdnUrl when available; raw storage_key is never returned to public callers.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ICreat.description: Create request body for adding attachments to a comment. This request references pre-uploaded storage objects and supplies minimal metadata required for server-side validation and persistence. Quarantined attachments will be recorded with quarantined=true and will not include public download URLs for non-privileged callers. The server is responsible for ownership checks (author or moderator), atomic quota enforcement, scan invocation, and audit logging.

storage_key.description: Object storage key or URI referencing an already-persisted file in the configured object storage. Required. Must reference an existing persisted object; the server will validate presence, accessibility and scan results before creating the attachment metadata record. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.storage_key.

original_filename.description: Original filename supplied by the client at upload time. Stored in discussion_board_comment_attachments.original_filename and used for display and export.

mime_type.description: MIME type reported on upload (e.g., image/png, application/pdf). The server validates allowed mime types and may override based on content inspection. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.mime_type.

size.description: File size in bytes as reported by the client. Server validates this value against configured per-file size limits and against the persisted storage object's metadata. Conservative maximum = 25,242,880 bytes (25 MB) to align with documented business constraints. Maps to Prisma column discussion_board_comment_attachments.size.

is_image.description: Optional hint indicating whether the file is an image. Server will infer authoritative value from mime_type and file inspection and will persist to discussion_board_comment_attachments.is_image. Inclusion is optional; omit or set null when unknown.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.IReque.description: Manifest item used for patch/update operations referencing a pre-uploaded storage object. Clients MUST upload binary to object storage first and then reference the resulting storage_key here. The server validates the storage_key, enforces allowed mime types and size limits, runs malware/abuse scanning, and may set quarantined=true for flagged items. DO NOT supply uploader or actor identifiers; the server derives the uploading member from the authenticated session.

attachments.description: Array of manifest items referencing pre-uploaded storage objects to create or update attachment metadata for the target comment. For MVP the server enforces a per-comment quota: max 1 attachment (minItems=1, maxItems=1). Do NOT duplicate path parameters (articleId, commentId) in the body. Clients MUST NOT include actor/session identifiers (e.g., discussion_board_uploaded_by_id) or quarantine flags; those are server-managed.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.IReque.description: Request body for patching (add/update) attachments for a comment. Each attachments entry's storage_key MUST reference an already persisted object; the server will validate existence, run malware/abuse scans, create discussion_board_comment_attachments rows and enforce per-comment quotas. The server sets discussion_board_comment_attachments.discussion_board_uploaded_by_id from the authenticated session and will audit creation.

IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.description:
Internal/detailed attachment metadata mapped to the Prisma model discussion_board_comment_attachments.

INTERNAL USE ONLY: This schema includes internal fields (storageKey) that MUST NOT be returned on public endpoints. Use IDiscussionBoardCommentAttachment.ISummary for any public or guest-facing responses. This detailed representation is intended for moderator/admin/internal consumers only and access MUST be privilege-gated and audited.

commentId.description: Identifier of the parent comment this attachment belongs to (maps to discussion_board_comment_id).

uploadedById.description: Uploading member id (nullable). Maps to discussion_board_uploaded_by_id. Nullable when uploader account was anonymized or removed. Consider returning a `uploader` summary object in public-facing variants instead of this raw id.

originalFilename.description: Filename as provided by the uploader (original_filename).

storageKey.description: Internal object storage key referencing the persisted file (storage_key). **SENSITIVE / INTERNAL**: DO NOT return this field to public consumers; it is intended only for internal/moderator views and must be protected. Provide signed `downloadUrl`/`cdnUrl` to public callers instead.

isImage.description: True when the attachment is an image type (is_image).

quarantined.description: True when the attachment is quarantined for malware or policy reasons. Quarantined attachments must not expose downloadUrl/cdnUrl to public callers.

createdAt.description: Upload timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) (created_at).

downloadUrl.description: Signed, time-limited URL for downloading the file via CDN/object-storage proxy. Provided to authorized clients or public consumers when the attachment is not quarantined. Null or omitted for quarantined attachments or when the caller is not authorized.

cdnUrl.description: Optional CDN URL for the attachment when available. Nullable when not provided or access restricted.

uploader.description: Optional summary of the uploading member for attribution. Nullable when uploader was removed. Prefer exposing this summary to public clients rather than raw uploadedById.

id.description: Primary identifier of the article-tag junction record (discussion_board_article_tags.id).

tag.description: Referenced tag summary object. Replaces the raw discussion_board_tag_id FK to provide context for clients.

created_by.description: Optional summary of the member who created the tag assignment (maps to discussion_board_article_tags.created_by_member_id). Nullable when the creating member was anonymized or removed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the tag was assigned to the article (discussion_board_article_tags.created_at).

IDiscussionBoardArticleTag.ISummary.description: Summary view of an article->tag assignment. This summary maps to the Prisma model `discussion_board_article_tags` and provides the assigned tag (as a summary object) plus minimal metadata. Use this type when listing tags attached to an article.

oneOf.description: Replacement payload: replace article tags with the provided list of tag slugs. The articleId is supplied as the path parameter and MUST NOT be duplicated in the body. The server MUST resolve each slug to an existing discussion_board_tags row, validate existence and active status, enforce per-article tag limits (max 10), and perform the assignment atomically. Use slug (not UUID) because the target entity exposes a unique `slug` field.

items.description: Tag slug (discussion_board_tags.slug). Use the canonical slug value (case-sensitive match per DB uniqueness rules).

tag_slugs.description: Array of tag slugs to set as the full tag list for the article. Replaces existing assignments atomically. Max 10 items.

if_match_version.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token (ETag or version) to prevent lost updates. When provided the server MUST validate the token and return 412/409 on mismatch per server policy.

oneOf.description: Action-based payload: add/remove discrete tag slugs. Provide at least one action (add or remove). Arrays, when present, must contain between 1 and 10 slugs. The articleId is provided in the path and created_by is derived from the authenticated actor; clients MUST NOT supply actor ids. The server MUST resolve slugs to tag ids transactionally and enforce tag limits.

add.description: List of tag slugs to add to the article. Each slug must resolve to an existing tag. When provided, array must have at least one item.

remove.description: List of tag slugs to remove from the article. Each slug must resolve to an existing tag.

if_match_version.description: Optional optimistic concurrency token (ETag or version) to prevent lost updates.

IDiscussionBoardArticleTag.IRequest.description: Request DTO for updating tag assignments on an article. Either provide a replacement list (`tag_slugs`) or an action-based object (`add`/`remove`). The implementation MUST validate tag existence, enforce per-article tag limits (max 10), resolve slugs to tag IDs within a transaction, and ensure the authenticated actor is used for created_by. ArticleId is expected in the path and MUST NOT be included in the body.

id.description: Primary identifier of the article-tag assignment (discussion_board_article_tags.id).

article.description: Summary of the article to which the tag is assigned. This replaces the raw foreign key (discussion_board_article_id) to provide contextual information; use article.id when the raw id is required.

tag.description: Summary of the tag assigned to the article. Replaces the raw foreign key (discussion_board_tag_id) to provide contextual information; use tag.id when the raw id is required.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the assignment was created (ISO 8601 UTC). Corresponds to discussion_board_article_tags.created_at in the Prisma model.

createdBy.description: Optional summary of the member who created the tag assignment. Maps to discussion_board_article_tags.created_by_member_id. Nullable when the creating member was anonymized or removed. NOTE: this value is derived server-side from the authenticated member for creation operations and MUST NOT be accepted from clients on create requests.

IDiscussionBoardArticleTag.description: Junction record linking an article to a tag. Response form intentionally transforms foreign keys into .ISummary objects to avoid exposing raw FK values and to prevent circular reference expansion. For creation, use IDiscussionBoardArticleTag.ICreate (accepts tagSlug with articleId as the path param); createdBy is set server-side from the authenticated member.

IDiscussionBoardArticleTag.ICreate.description: Create DTO for assigning an existing tag to an article. The articleId is provided as the path parameter (not in the body). The authenticated member identity (createdByMemberId) is derived server-side and MUST NOT be supplied by the client. The server resolves tagSlug -> discussion_board_tags.id, validates tag existence and active state, enforces per-article tag limits, and enforces the junction table uniqueness constraint. The server will normalize the slug (trim, lower-case) before lookup.

tagSlug.description: Tag slug (discussion_board_tags.slug). Use the canonical slug value (recommended lower-case, no spaces). The server will trim and normalize casing before lookup. Example: "inflation".

IDiscussionBoardReport.description: Discussion board report entity mapped to Prisma model discussion_board_reports. Represents a member-submitted report about a polymorphic target (article, comment, attachment). NOTE: reporter_member_id is server-derived (read-only) and clients MUST NOT supply it in create requests; reporter_session_id is nullable and considered sensitive (PII) and exposure is restricted to authorized callers and audited. Duplicate reports (reporter_member_id + target_type + target_id) result in 409 Conflict.

reporter_member_id.description: UUID of the member who filed the report. This field is populated by the server from the authenticated principal and is readOnly in API input contexts (clients MUST NOT set this value).

reporter_session_id.description: Optional session id of the reporter (nullable). Treated as sensitive context (PII) and returned only to authorized callers; inclusion in responses is audited.

target_id.description: Identifier of the reported target resource; interpreted according to target_type.

explanation.description: Optional free-text explanation provided by the reporter. Server WILL sanitize this field before persisting or displaying (max 1000 characters enforced at request time).

status.description: Processing status for the report. Use canonical values defined by the application (e.g., 'pending','triaged','resolved').

created_at.description: Timestamp when the report was created (ISO 8601 UTC).

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the report was first processed (nullable). Set/updated by moderation workflows.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the report was resolved/closed (nullable). Set by moderation workflows.

IDiscussionBoardReport.ICreate.description: Create DTO for filing a moderation report. Clients MUST NOT provide server-derived fields such as reporter_member_id, status or created_at. The authenticated member identity will be recorded server-side as reporter_member_id. The request must include a valid target_type and target_id that correspond to an existing resource. reason_category must be one of the canonical values. explanation is optional (max 1000 characters) and will be sanitized.

target_type.description: Polymorphic target type. Allowed exact values: 'article', 'comment', 'attachment'. Case-sensitive.

target_id.description: UUID of the reported target resource. Must reference an existing resource of the specified target_type.

reason_category.description: Reason category for the report. Use one of the canonical values (case-sensitive): 'Spam','Harassment','Misinformation','Illegal','Other'.

explanation.description: Optional free-text explanation provided by the reporter (max 1000 chars). Server will sanitize to remove PII and dangerous content. Nullable.

v0.explanation: Repeated targeted insults and doxxing attempts in replies.

IDiscussionBoardReport.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for moderator updates to a report's processing state. Only moderators may call this endpoint. All fields are OPTIONAL for partial update semantics; the server applies only provided fields. The server enforces allowed status values and validates timestamps. Note: closed_at MUST NOT be earlier than the report's created_at; the server enforces this invariant and will return 400 on violation.

oneOf.description: Canonical processing status for the report. Allowed values (exact): 'pending','triaged','resolved'.
Canonical processing status for the report. Allowed values (exact): 'pending','triaged','resolved'.
Canonical processing status for the report. Allowed values (exact): 'pending','triaged','resolved'.

status.description: Canonical processing status for the report. Allowed values (exact): 'pending','triaged','resolved'.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the report was first processed (ISO 8601 UTC). Server may set this automatically when status changes to a processed state.

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the report was resolved/closed (ISO 8601 UTC). If provided, the server validates closed_at >= created_at for the report and rejects earlier values with 400 Bad Request.

oneOf.description: Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.
Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.
Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.
Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.
Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.

IDiscussionBoardReportReasonCategory.description: Enumerated reason categories for reports used by the moderation workflow.

oneOf.description: Canonical processing status for a report in the moderation workflow.
Canonical processing status for a report in the moderation workflow.
Canonical processing status for a report in the moderation workflow.

IDiscussionBoardReportStatus.description: Canonical processing status for a report in the moderation workflow.

IDiscussionBoardReport.ISummary.description: Summary of a member-submitted report. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_reports. This summary is intended for moderator queues and intentionally excludes session-level fields (reporter_session_id). Added reporterMemberId and aggregated counters (reportCount, uniqueReporterCount) to align with moderationQueue operation expectations.

reporterMemberId.description: Reporter member id (discussion_board_reports.reporter_member_id). Nullable when reporter account was removed or redacted. NOTE: returning this field should be restricted to moderator/audit contexts and access must be recorded.

reporter.description: Optional summary of the reporting member. Provided to give moderator context without exposing session-level PII. Nullable when reporter account was removed or redaction is required.

reasonCategory.description: Report reason category (enum). Uses canonical enum schema for validation and consistency.

createdAt.description: When the report was created (ISO 8601 UTC).

processedAt.description: Timestamp when a moderator or automation first processed the report. Nullable if not yet processed.

closedAt.description: Timestamp when the report was resolved/closed. Nullable until closed.

explanationExcerpt.description: Short sanitized excerpt (up to 500 chars) from the reporter's explanation to assist triage squads. Full explanation text is sensitive and should be returned only from detail endpoints under elevated privileges.

reportCount.description: Aggregated number of reports observed for the same target (derived via grouping on target_type + target_id). Optional; provided to help prioritize moderation. Nullable when aggregation not computed by the service.

uniqueReporterCount.description: Aggregated number of unique reporters for the same target (derived via grouping distinct reporter_member_id). Optional; provided to help prioritize moderation. Nullable when aggregation not computed by the service.

IDiscussionBoardReport.IRequest.description: Request DTO for searching and paginating moderation reports. Used by moderator endpoints to express filters, date ranges, full-text search and pagination. Added `priority` filter (boolean) and explicit sort tokens to align with moderationQueue and moderator endpoints.

limit.description: Maximum items per page. Server enforces a maximum (recommended 100). Default 20.

reporterMemberId.description: Filter reports submitted by a specific member (UUID). Nullable; only honored for authorized moderator callers.

targetId.description: Filter by a specific target resource id (UUID).

createdFrom.description: Start of createdAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

createdTo.description: End of createdAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

processedFrom.description: Start of processedAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

processedTo.description: End of processedAt range (inclusive). ISO 8601 datetime.

search.description: Free-text search applied to report explanation; server should enforce query timeouts for heavy searches.

sortBy.description: Sort expression. Allowed tokens (exact): 'createdAt', '-createdAt', 'processedAt', '-processedAt', 'priority'. Servers MUST validate tokens and return 400 when unsupported values are provided.

includeProcessed.description: If true include processed reports in results; default false.

includeClosed.description: If true include closed reports (closedAt IS NOT NULL) in results. Default: false.

includeReporterContext.description: Request inclusion of reporter context (e.g., reporter display name). Returning session-level PII (reporterSessionId) requires elevated audit privileges and is audited when provided.

priority.description: Optional derived-priority predicate. When true return only items flagged as high-priority by aggregation heuristics (e.g., reportCount threshold or automated scoring). Nullable/optional.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.ICreate.description: Request DTO to create a moderation action. Clients MUST NOT supply moderator_id; the acting moderator is derived automatically from the authenticated principal. Maps to Prisma model discussion_board_moderation_actions. Use this payload to request creation of an auditable moderation action and to trigger enforcement workers.

oneOf.description: Optional reference to an originating report (discussion_board_reports.id). When provided the server validates existence and will return 400/404 if the referenced report cannot be found or is in an invalid state.

discussion_board_report_id.description: Optional reference to an originating report (discussion_board_reports.id). Nullable when the action is not tied to a specific report.

oneOf.description: Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'. When using 'suspend' consider supplying action_duration_days to indicate suspension length.

Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'. For permanent bans omit action_duration_days (server treats null as permanent unless policy requires otherwise).

action_type.description: Type of moderation action to record. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.

oneOf.description: Optional short moderator-provided reason describing the rationale for the action. Server will persist and include this in audit records; keep it concise.

action_reason.description: Optional short moderator-provided reason describing the rationale for the action.

oneOf.description: Optional duration in days for time-limited sanctions (e.g., suspension length). When provided the server computes effective_until = created_at + action_duration_days. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1).

action_duration_days.description: Optional duration in days for time-limited sanctions (e.g., suspension length). When provided the server computes effective_until = created_at + action_duration_days. Must be a positive integer (minimum 1).

oneOf.description: Polymorphic target type: article.
Polymorphic target type: comment.
Polymorphic target type: member.
Polymorphic target type: attachment.

target_type.description: Polymorphic target type of the action. Allowed values: 'article','comment','member','attachment'.

target_id.description: Identifier of the acted-upon resource; interpretation depends on target_type. Server validates that the referenced resource exists and that the moderator has authority to act on it.

oneOf.description: Optional timestamp when the action becomes effective. If omitted, server will set to creation time (created_at). When provided, server validates chronology (effective_from >= now or per policy).

effective_from.description: Optional timestamp when the action becomes effective. If omitted, server will set to creation time.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.description: Detailed moderation action record returned by the API. Represents a persisted discussion_board_moderation_actions row with API-facing (camelCase) property names. Include linked moderator summary and optional originating report summary when the caller is authorized. Nullable fields reflect the underlying Prisma model nullability.

id.description: Unique identifier of the moderation action (discussion_board_moderation_actions.id).

oneOf.description: Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.
Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.

actionType.description: Type of moderation action applied. Allowed values: 'hide','remove','warn','suspend','ban'.

actionReason.description: Optional moderator-provided short reason describing the rationale for the action. Nullable when the moderator provided no reason.

actionDurationDays.description: Optional duration in days for time-limited sanctions (e.g., suspension length). When present the server computes effectiveUntil = effectiveFrom + actionDurationDays (business semantics). Nullable for non-duration actions.

appellant_member_id.description: Member id of the appellant (discussion_board_appeals.appellant_member_id). This field is non-nullable in the Prisma model and is populated server-side from the authenticated caller. It MUST be present in persisted records.

IDiscussionBoardModerationAction.ISummar.description: Summary view of a moderation action. Includes key scalar properties and a summary object for the acting moderator. This type is intentionally minimal to avoid circular expansion and is intended for list and embedding scenarios.

IDiscussionBoardAppeal.ISummary.description: Sanitized summary representation of an appeal. Provides actor context (appellant), current status and optional links to the moderation action and report. Intended for moderator/admin list views; sensitive fields are excluded and full appeal detail is available only from privileged detail endpoints.

appellant.description: Summary of the member who submitted the appeal (sanitized). Mapped from discussion_board_appeals.appellant_member_id. This summary excludes sensitive PII such as email or password_hash; return only the public summary fields.

oneOf.description: Current processing status of the appeal. Canonical allowed values: 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected'. Use the exact literal values defined by the application lifecycle.
Current processing status of the appeal. Canonical allowed values: 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected'. Use the exact literal values defined by the application lifecycle.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the appeal was submitted (ISO 8601 UTC).

resolved_at.description: Resolution timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Nullable until resolved.

moderation_action.description: Optional summary of the moderation action under appeal. Mapped from discussion_board_appeals.moderation_action_id. Nullable when the appeal references only a report or no action is yet associated.

Sort expression. Allowed values: '-createdAt' (default, most recent first) or 'createdAt' (oldest first). Default: '-createdAt'.

IDiscussionBoardAppeal.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for modifying mutable fields of an appeal. Used by moderators to record resolutions and link moderation actions. The server enforces allowed status transitions and validates referenced moderationActionId if supplied.

status.description: New status for the appeal. Use the canonical enum values defined in IEDiscussionBoardAppealStatus. The server validates allowed transitions (for example, 'pending' -> 'accepted'|'rejected') and will reject invalid transitions with 400.

resolutionReason.description: Moderator-provided resolution note explaining the decision. Optional; provide null to clear the resolutionReason. Server will sanitize and persist to discussion_board_appeals.resolution_reason.

resolve_accept.resolutionReason: After review we accept the appeal and restore content.

IDiscussionBoardSearch.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for global search across articles, comments, attachments and tags. Contains the required query string plus optional filters, pagination primitives (page, limit) and sorting options. NOTE: This is a REQUEST schema — do not use response pagination wrappers here. Field names use camelCase to align with API conventions.

Filters summary (see `filters` property): supported keys include:
- types: array of entity types to include (e.g., ['article','comment','attachment','tag'])
- categoryId: UUID to filter articles by primary category
- tagSlugs: array of tag slug strings to filter articles by tags
- authorUsername: exact username (discussion_board_member.username)
- createdFrom / createdTo: ISO 8601 datetimes to restrict created/published date ranges

Visibility note: Public callers MUST expect that results are already filtered server-side to exclude soft-deleted or moderation-hidden/quarantined content (deleted_at != null, state != 'published', is_hidden = true, quarantined = true).

query.description: Non-empty full-text search query used to search article titles/content, comment text, tag names and author display names. Clients must provide a non-empty string.

filters.description: Optional named filter object (IDiscussionBoardSearch.IFilters) to restrict the search results. Use camelCase keys: types (string[]), categoryId (uuid), tagSlugs (string[]), authorUsername (string), createdFrom (ISO 8601 datetime), createdTo (ISO 8601 datetime).

limit.description: Number of items per page. Server enforces a maximum of 100.

oneOf.description: Sort by relevance (default).
Sort by newest - maps to published_at desc (fallback to created_at when published_at is null).
Sort by oldest - maps to published_at asc (fallback to created_at when published_at is null).

sort.description: Sort order for results. Mapping: 'newest'/'oldest' map to published_at where applicable, otherwise created_at. Use 'relevance' for full-text scoring.

highlight.description: When true, the response may include highlighted snippets for matched fields to assist UI presentation. This may increase payload size.

basicSearch.summary: Search articles and comments for 'inflation' in economics category, pinned first page

IDiscussionBoardSearchResult.ISummary.description: Summary view of an article used in search results and listings. Maps to the Prisma model discussion_board_articles. This summary provides minimal fields required to render a list item and includes belongs-to references as .ISummary objects for context. Fields that are derived (excerpt, thumbnail) are optional and presentation-only. Note: author is nullable to reflect Prisma nullability when articles are anonymized or the author was removed.

title.description: Article title (short form) used for listing and search snippets.

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt or lead text derived from the article content suitable for list display. This field is presentation-derived and may be null when not computed.

author.description: Optional author summary. Nullable to reflect Prisma column discussion_board_member_id which is nullable (anonymized or removed authors).

category.description: Primary category for the article. Nullable when an article has no assigned category.

tags.description: Array of tag summaries applied to the article (classification). May be an empty array when no tags are assigned. Server SHOULD return [] rather than omitting the property.

is_pinned.description: Whether the article is pinned in listing views (matches discussion_board_articles.is_pinned).

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the article in ISO 8601 UTC (discussion_board_articles.created_at).

published_at.description: Publication timestamp when the article became public. Null for drafts.

thumbnail.description: Optional thumbnail URL for the article (derived from attachments). This field is presentation-only and may be null when no thumbnail exists.

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description:
Time-series and summary metrics of article activity (articles, comments, attachments) for the requested date range.

Notes:
- All aggregates exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) and moderation-hidden records (articles where state != 'published' or comments with is_hidden = true).
- Date bucketing uses UTC calendar days (ISO 8601 date string, YYYY-MM-DD). Server SHOULD normalize timestamps to UTC before bucketing.
- average_comments_per_article is a nullable number: null when article_count is zero; otherwise a floating-point value (presentation may round to 2 decimal places).

summary.description: Overall summary metrics computed for the requested range. Counts are integer totals for the range and exclude soft-deleted/hidden items.

article_count.description: Total number of published articles in the period (excludes soft-deleted or hidden items).

comment_count.description: Total number of comments in the period (excludes deleted or hidden comments).

attachment_count.description: Total number of attachments uploaded in the period (excludes deleted/quarantined attachments).

average_comments_per_article.description: Computed as comment_count / article_count when article_count > 0. Null when article_count == 0 to avoid division by zero. Use floating point; recommended client presentation: round to two decimal places.

time_series.description: Array of daily aggregation buckets for the requested date range, ordered by date descending. Each bucket contains day-level counts (UTC calendar day).

top_tags.description: Top tags used across articles in the period ordered by usage count. Each item contains tag display name, slug and usage count. May be an empty array when no tags were used.

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description: Daily aggregation bucket representing counts for a single calendar day within the requested range.

date.description: Calendar day in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) representing the bucket date.

article_count.description: Number of published articles on this day (excludes soft-deleted/hidden).

comment_count.description: Number of comments created on this day (excludes deleted/hidden).

attachment_count.description: Number of attachments uploaded on this day (excludes deleted/quarantined).

IDiscussionBoardArticleActivityStatistic.description: Summary of a tag and its usage count within the requested period. Derived from discussion_board_article_tags join with discussion_board_tags. Counts exclude associations to soft-deleted or hidden articles.

slug.description: Tag slug (discussion_board_tags.slug). Use canonical slug for filtering/URLs.

count.description: Number of times the tag was used in the requested period (non-negative integer).

IDiscussionBoardArticlesMonthlyStatistic.description: Monthly aggregated statistics for discussion_board_articles. Each object represents a calendar month (represented as the month-start timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC) and includes counts broken down by state and derived metrics. Implementation note: published_count is computed by grouping rows where discussion_board_articles.published_at is not null using DATE_TRUNC('month', published_at); draft_count is computed from discussion_board_articles in the 'draft' state using DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) because drafts typically have published_at = null. The aggregation MUST exclude rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL. Implementers should document these two separate bucketing strategies (published_by_published_at vs drafts_by_created_at) and consider precomputing materialized views for large datasets.

month.description: Month bucket represented as the month-start ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC (e.g., '2025-10-01T00:00:00Z'). Use this canonical representation for ordering and display.

published_count.description: Number of articles that were published in this calendar month. Computed by grouping discussion_board_articles by DATE_TRUNC('month', published_at) and counting rows where state = 'published' and deleted_at IS NULL.

draft_count.description: Number of articles that were in 'draft' state created in this calendar month. IMPORTANT: drafts typically have published_at = null, so this value is computed by grouping discussion_board_articles by DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) and counting rows where state = 'draft' and deleted_at IS NULL. This explicit semantic avoids the common mistake of attempting to derive draft counts from published_at buckets.

pending_review_count.description: Number of articles that were in 'pending_review' state during the chosen month. Implementation may choose to count items whose state was 'pending_review' at any time in the month or to count snapshots; document the chosen semantics. Exclude rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

hidden_count.description: Number of articles that were in the 'hidden' state during the month (typically due to moderation or automated hide). Exclude rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

distinct_authors_published.description: Count of unique discussion_board_member_id values for articles published in the month (used as denominator when computing per-author averages). Excludes null/anonymous authors and rows with deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

average_published_per_author.description: Derived metric computed as published_count / greatest(distinct_authors_published, 1). Implementations should compute this as a floating-point value and document the rounding strategy used (e.g., 2 decimal places).

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.IRequest.description: Search request for discussion_board_audit_logs. Contains optional filters, full-text search over the metadata column (GIN/trigram), pagination and sorting. Intended for privileged moderator usage; caller identity is taken from authentication context and must not be supplied here. Date range filters map to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp and are inclusive.

eventType.description: Exact-match filter for event_type (for example: 'auth.login', 'moderation.action'). Server may validate against known event types.

actorType.description: Filter by actor_type (for example: 'member','moderator','system'). Use only known classifications. Caller must be authorized to filter by actor-related fields.

actorId.description: Filter by actor_id (UUID). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.actor_id. This filter exposes PII and MUST be honored only for callers with appropriate privileges; accesses should be audited.

resourceId.description: Filter by resource_id (UUID). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.resource_id. Use only when caller is authorized to query resource-level audit events.

fullText.description: Free-text search applied to the metadata column (serialized JSON) using the DB GIN/trigram index. This is a privileged operation: queries may be rate-limited, results may be redacted for PII, and full payload access may require elevated permissions.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive lower bound for event_timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

dateTo.description: Inclusive upper bound for event_timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Maps to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based). Default is 1. Server enforces a minimum of 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default 20. Server MUST enforce an upper bound (recommended max 100) to protect the system and avoid extremely large synchronous responses.

sort.description: Sort expression. Typical values: 'event_timestamp' (ascending) or '-event_timestamp' (descending). Server validates supported sort keys.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.ISummary.description: Concise summary of an audit-log entry (discussion_board_audit_logs). Intended for listing and triage. The full serialized metadata payload is intentionally excluded from this summary. To retrieve full event_payload callers require an elevated/detail endpoint and appropriate privileges; such accesses MUST be audited.

id.description: Primary key: unique identifier of the audit log entry (discussion_board_audit_logs.id).

event_type.description: Canonical event type describing the audited event (for example: 'auth.login','moderation.action'). Use dot notation for hierarchical classification when applicable.

event_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC). Corresponds to discussion_board_audit_logs.event_timestamp.

resource_type.description: Optional resource type targeted by the event (for example: 'article','comment','attachment'). Nullable for system-level events.

resource_id.description: Optional UUID of the resource targeted by the event (discussion_board_audit_logs.resource_id). Nullable when no resource is targeted.

actor_type.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action (for example: 'member','moderator','system'). Nullable for system events.

actor_id.description: Actor identifier (UUID) when applicable (discussion_board_audit_logs.actor_id). May be null when actor was anonymized or when event is system-generated. This field may contain PII and should be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges; the server MUST log accesses to unredacted audit responses.

created_at.description: Record insertion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). For audit semantics this is typically set by the application and corresponds to discussion_board_audit_logs.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Audit records are append-only and updates are exceptional; this field is nullable and mirrors discussion_board_audit_logs.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Administrative soft-delete timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). Presence indicates the record has been administratively marked; use is restricted by policy. Mirrors discussion_board_audit_logs.deleted_at.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLog.description: Append-only audit log entry mapped to the Prisma model `discussion_board_audit_logs`. Contains canonical forensic snapshot of a system or user event. The `metadata` property contains serialized JSON text (string) and may be redacted for callers without unredacted-audit privileges. All timestamps use ISO 8601 UTC format.

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit record (UUID).

event_type.description: Canonical event type (e.g. 'auth.login','moderation.action','export.request'). Use dot notation for hierarchical classification.

event_timestamp.description: Time when the audited event occurred (ISO 8601 UTC).

resource_type.description: Optional resource type the event targets (e.g., 'article','comment','attachment'). Null when event is system-level with no resource.

resource_id.description: Optional UUID of the target resource. Interpreted according to resource_type; may be null for non-resource events.

oneOf.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).
Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).

actor_type.description: Classification of the actor that performed the action. Use the canonical values (member, moderator, system, guest).

actor_id.description: Optional actor identifier (UUID) when applicable. Nullable for system events or anonymized actors. THIS FIELD MAY BE REDACTED in responses returned to callers without unredacted-audit privileges; when redacted the API SHOULD return null and record the access in audit-access logs.

ip.description: Observed IP address for the event when available. May be redacted for callers without unredacted privileges. Consider storing in logs but returning null to non-privileged API clients.

user_agent.description: User agent or client hint captured at event time. May be null or redacted for non-privileged callers.

metadata.description: Serialized event payload stored as JSON text (string) containing event-specific details for forensic reconstruction. MAY contain PII and therefore MUST BE REDACTED for callers without unredacted-audit privileges. Recommended consumer guidance: attempt to parse the string as JSON if present. Keep payloads reasonably sized; extremely large payloads should be truncated or referenced via external forensic storage.

created_at.description: Record insertion timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC). For audit semantics this is typically set by the application to match event_timestamp where possible.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp. Audit records are append-only and updates are exceptional; updates should be rare and audited. In many implementations updated_at == created_at for append-only entries unless an authorized correction occurred.

deleted_at.description: Optional administrative soft-delete marker. Use is restricted by policy.

IDiscussionBoardAuditLogAccess.IRequest.description: Request body for listing audit-log-access entries. Contains pagination, filtering and optional date range filters. Do NOT include the auditLogId in the body; it is provided in the path.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Default is 1. Server enforces sensible maxima to prevent expensive queries.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Default is 20. Server may enforce a lower maxLimit for heavy queries.

oneOf.description: Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.

Optional filter for accessorType (enumerated). Allowed exact values: 'moderator', 'administrator', 'system', 'guest'. Use these exact token values. When provided, the server filters access records by accessorType.
